change.title: Remove the unregistered legacy Skill Manager without changing production behavior
change.summary: Deletes the uncompiled commands/skills.rs and skill_manager module tree, replaces the stale production-path test input with the registered commands/skill_install.rs surface, and narrowly records these proven orphan paths as reviewed source retirements while keeping all other rename, copy, and delete impact fail-closed. The registered local and Gateway Skill bridges, DTOs, runtime mutation ownership, package core, and product behavior are unchanged.

basis: lib.rs, commands/mod.rs, the Tauri invoke surface, repository callers, and Cargo manifests contain no legacy Skill Manager module or command registration
the stable Skill runtime boundary test asserts the legacy files are absent and scans the registered commands/skill_install.rs production surface
the retired-path policy binds this active record and requires its unique introduction to contain only the approved 12 Desktop deletions; all other rename, copy, and delete cases remain fail-closed
the runtime mutation inventory continues to map only current registered Skill bridge owners and writers
focused Skill boundary, Rust, quality policy, runtime mutation inventory, metadata, impact, and the canonical source gate are required before source closure
